rules.remedy: Place a red or orange light in the SE corner of the kitchen. If kitchen cannot be moved, keep the cooking stove/gas in the SE portion of the kitchen.
rules.description: Kitchen represents the fire element (Agni). SE is governed by Agni, making it the ideal zone.

rules.remedy: Use earthy tones (yellow, brown, beige) in the bedroom. Place heavy furniture in the SW corner. Avoid mirrors facing the bed.
rules.description: SW represents earth element and stability. Master bedroom here ensures authority and restful sleep for the head of household.

rules.remedy: Keep bathroom door closed at all times. Place a Vastu pyramid near the bathroom entrance. Use light colors inside.
rules.description: Bathroom/toilet in NE (the most sacred direction, governed by water/Ishanya) is one of the most severe Vastu defects. NW (Vayu zone) is ideal for drainage.

rules.remedy: If pooja room cannot be in NE, create a small altar in the NE corner of the living room or any room. Face east or north while praying.
rules.description: NE (Ishanya) is considered the most spiritually charged direction, ideal for prayer and meditation.

rules.remedy: Ensure the seating arrangement has guests facing east or north. Add indoor plants in the NE corner of the living room.
rules.description: Living room benefits from the positive energy flow of northern and eastern light. Center placement is acceptable in larger homes.

rules.remedy: If entrance faces SW, place a bright light above the door. Use a threshold (brass or wooden). Hang a toran or auspicious symbol at the entrance.
rules.description: Main entrance is the highest-weight Vastu factor. NE entrance invites maximum positive energy. SW entrance is considered the most inauspicious.

rules.remedy: Use calming colors. Place bed so head points south or east. Avoid electronic devices near the bed.
rules.description: Secondary bedrooms are best in the southern or western zones for restful sleep.

rules.remedy: Face east or north while studying/working. Place a globe or crystal in the NE corner.
rules.description: NE and N zones enhance concentration, clarity, and wisdom.

rules.remedy: Use warm colors. Place a mirror on the east wall to reflect the dining table (symbolizes abundance).
rules.description: Dining room does best in western or eastern zones. Should ideally be adjacent to or near the kitchen.

rules.remedy: Place plants on northern and eastern balconies. Keep balcony clean and uncluttered.
rules.description: Open spaces in N/NE/E allow positive energy and morning sunlight to enter.

rules.remedy: Keep heavy items in SW storage. NE storage should be kept minimal and light.
rules.description: Heavy storage items align with the earth element of SW. NE should remain light and open.

rules.remedy: Keep the drawing room well-lit and clutter-free. Place seating so guests face north or east.
rules.description: Drawing room (formal living area) follows the same principles as living room. N/NE/E zones welcome positive social energy.
